competitors.what_they_have: The Spanish page to beat. Visible 'ACTUALIZADO 13 enero 2026' date, question-style H2s (¿Estoy obligado?, ¿Qué es el año fiscal?, ¿Cuándo tengo que hacer el trámite?), worked numeric example, deductions list, a 4-step myTax screenshot tutorial (contact details, financial institution, personalise return, lodge), ABN section, a tip on getting the myGov code from abroad, names Argentina/Uruguay/Chile as 462 countries. Weaknesses: figures tied to 2024/25, a 32.5% bracket that no longer applies, no Medicare levy, no Chile resident-rate rule, no early lodgement rule, no FAQ block, advises answering 'NO' to residency without nuance.

Commercial page: WhatsApp-first CTA repeated, 4-step process, 6 FAQs (obligatoria, cuánto se devuelve, cuánto cuesta, superannuation, hace falta estar en Australia, quién asesora), Spanish-speaking experts, a super cross-sell. Uses average refund figures and price anchors (we must not copy either). No dates, no official sources, no reviews.

Spanish long guide with a rates table, three lodgement routes (myGov, agent, paper), refund timing (about 2 weeks online), a 5-point checklist, common mistakes. Outdated 2023-24 table and an 18,200 tax-free threshold that does not apply to WHMs; no FAQ.
English page that ranks for the Spanish queries: step list, documents to gather, deadline, leaving-Australia notes.

Official 2025-26 WHM rules, including the eight nationalities (Chile among them) who pay resident rates when Australian residents for tax purposes. Ranks for 'cómo hacer el tax return visa 462' despite being English.

changes.new_text:
Si lo haces tú en myTax, estos son los pasos:

  1. Crea tu cuenta de myGov y vincúlala con la ATO. Si estás fuera de Australia, configura antes el acceso desde el extranjero.
  2. Revisa que cada empleador aparezca con su income statement. Si falta uno, no presentes todavía.
  3. En la sección de working holiday maker, elige tu país e indica qué ingresos y deducciones corresponden a la visa 462 o 417.
  4. Si tu pasaporte no tiene acuerdo de salud con Australia, pide la exención del Medicare levy con el Medicare Entitlement Statement. Si no, el 2 % queda aplicado.
  5. Indica una cuenta bancaria australiana para la devolución y presenta.

Fuentes: ATO, sección working holiday maker y ATO, presentar desde fuera de Australia. Declaración por tu cuenta o con agente.

facts.fact: WHM rates 2025-26 and 2026-27: 15% to 45,000 AUD, 30% to 135,000, 37% to 190,000, 45% above. WHMs cannot claim the tax-free threshold.
Medicare levy 2% of taxable income; exemption via Medicare Entitlement Statement for non-RHCA countries; Spain and Latin American countries are not RHCA countries.
Self-lodger deadline 31 October; for 2025-26 it was 31 October 2026, passed; a late return can still be lodged.

The 2025-26 WHM section applies if 'at any time during 2025-26 you earned income while in Australia on a subclass 417 or 462 visa'. Australian residents for tax purposes who are nationals of Chile, Finland, Germany, Israel, Japan, Norway, Turkey or the United Kingdom pay resident rates, even if also nationals of another country; foreign residents and residents of other nationalities pay WHM rates.
Addy v Commissioner of Taxation [2021] HCA 34 may change which rates apply; assessed case by case.
facts.source: public/llms.txt Key facts (High Court of Australia)

facts.fact: From overseas: 'The easiest way to lodge your tax return from overseas is to lodge your tax return online with myTax'; need 'a myGov account with an active link to the ATO'; 'update your myGov sign in settings to ensure you have access from overseas'; recommends a Digital ID such as myID; 'have an Australian bank account you can use to receive any refund amounts'; normal lodgment period 1 July to 31 October.

Early lodgement only if leaving Australia permanently before 30 June and (foreign resident) no further Australian-sourced income other than interest, dividends or royalties; paper tax return; 'Processing for early lodgments is 50 business days.'
'Most returns lodged online process within 10 business days.'
Site wording kept: if there is a refund it usually arrives about 14 business days after lodgement.
